O.outcome_detail: self-reported learning need regarding own strengths and weaknesses in communication

cells.quote: Regarding learning needs, a significant difference emerged in terms of a higher value in the group with data at T0 and T1 regarding one’s own strengths and weaknesses in communication (M=4.1 vs. 3.8, F(1.260)=3.99, p=.047).
cells.note: The contrast is a dropout analysis, not a treatment comparison.

O.outcome_detail: self-assessed confidence in taking a patient’s history

cells.quote: The self-assessments of the students’ own skills at T0 showed differences in the confidence in the ability to take a patient’s history (M=2.5 in the group with data for T0 and T1 vs. 2.2, F(1.264)=6.19, p=.013)
cells.note: The contrast is a dropout analysis, not a treatment comparison.

O.outcome_detail: self-assessed knowledge of how to disclose a diagnosis comprehensibly

cells.quote: The self-assessments of the students’ own skills at T0 showed differences in knowing how disclose a diagnosis in a comprehensible fashion (3.1 vs. 2.7, F(1,266)=11:43, p=.001)
cells.note: The contrast is a dropout analysis, not a treatment comparison.

O.outcome_detail: self-assessed confidence in disclosing a serious diagnosis

cells.quote: The self-assessments of the students’ own skills at T0 showed differences in the confidence in regard to actually disclosing a serious diagnosis (2.7 vs. 2.4, F(1.266)=4.63, p=.032).
cells.note: The contrast is a dropout analysis, not a treatment comparison.
